title: Oracle November 2026 Critical Security Patch Update fixes hundreds of flaws including Java4Shell
summary: Oracle's November Critical Security Patch Update has 655 new patches, per SecurityWeek. SecurityWeek counts 948 unique CVEs, 640 of them in risk matrices; just over 300 patches fix flaws exploitable remotely without authentication and 62 fix critical flaws. Hyperion has the most fixes (267). Java SE includes the fix for Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938). Oracle makes no mention of exploitation of these flaws.
plain: Oracle released its big quarterly security update, fixing hundreds of flaws across its products, including the serious Java flaw known as Java4Shell.
exec: A large quarterly patch load across Oracle products, including just over 300 patches for flaws exploitable remotely without authentication, per SecurityWeek.
action: Apply the November 2026 CSPU as soon as possible, including the Java SE update that fixes Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938).

key_findings: 655 new patches; SecurityWeek counts 948 unique CVEs.
About 300 unauthenticated and remotely exploitable; 62 critical.
